evidence_notes: Diagnosed ten years ago. Also has ankylosing spondylitis and chronic kidney disease from NSAID use. Started biologics immediately (Remicade for both, then Humira for Crohn's). Remicade worked initially but stopped. Humira less effective (40%). Kidney disease limits stronger options. Work impossible, on disability. Lost house, divorced. Dating impossible. Financial dependence on elderly parents. Considering surgery but recovery concerns with AS. Currently on Humira, seeking new treatment. Doctor wants to try Stelara.
